csv_project_name: DB for CMU Dymally Building Project
csv_scope_of_work: The State of California, acting through the Board of Trustees of The California State University, hereinafter called Trustees or BOT, on behalf of California State University, Dominguez Hills, hereinafter called University, is seeking proposals from Design-Builders (Proposers) to provide pre-construction and construction services for the project referenced above (Project). New Construction of 8000 SF CMU Building for the Marvyn M. Dymally African American Political & Economic Institute (MDAAPEI), located adjacent to the northeast of the CSUDH College of Continuing & Professional Education (CCPE) and the Orthotics and Prosthetics (O&P) buildings. The new Dymally Institute includes gallery, offices, conference room, auditorium, courtyard, and various support spaces.
